name: red-handed
description: Audit what a coding agent actually did against what it said it did, from the session transcript and the repository's git state.

plugins.name: red-handed
plugins.description: Reads this project's Claude Code session transcripts under ~/.claude/projects, lines them up against git, and reports where a claim is not supported by the record: tests reported as passing with no run behind them, an expected value rewritten to match a failure, a test switched off, a commit made past a rejecting hook. Local files only, no network, no model calls.
